leadText:
----
 
Alex (Japanese: アズマ Azuma) is a character of the day who appeared in Taming of the Shroomish.

 
During Alex's childhood, he used to play with the many that shared a mansion called the Green Lodge with his . Unfortunately, as time went on, the forest around the mansion was being cut down to make way for buildings. Eventually, all of the Shroomish left the mansion.

By the events of Taming of the Shroomish, the Rinshin Town council had begun the clearing of the mansion site to make way for new development. However, these plans were marred by strange occurrences, and the workers complaining of feeling sick from the mansion. Alex would occasionally check up on the progress, and during one of his visits he spotted and on the property. He ordered them to move off the demolition zone, but Max insisted that he was simply following after a Shroomish. Alex refuted the claims, but decided to investigate the mansion out of curiosity.

Inside the mansion, they soon located the Shroomish that Max had earlier befriended. A stampede of Shroomish later appeared when first arrived to steal . Alex was surprised that the Shroomish had been living inside the Green Lodge all this time. Having witnessed the Shroomish defend the mansion against Team Rocket a second time, Alex decided that the demolition would still go ahead. But instead of new development, he would restore the property to a forest perfect for the Shroomish to live in.
